title: 5 of Co’s ex-personnel to testify in Romualdez bail hearing — lawyer
summary: Five of the former personnel of ex-lawmaker Zaldy Co will testify in the bail hearing of Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez, lawyer Levito Baligod said on Wednesday.
